verdict.rationale: A package registry could plausibly offer a sandbox or staging registry for testing publishes and installs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only that npm can point at any compatible registry or one you run yourself (e.g. third-party Verdaccio). That is a developer building block or user-side arrangement, not a first-party sandbox environment. No dry-run or isolated test mode is evidenced either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
